de.name: Viewpoint with iconic photo of Haile Selassie
de.text: Dieser Aussichtspunkt ist historisch bedeutsam, da er das ikonische Foto des ehemaligen Kaisers Haile Selassie zeigt.

hu.name: Viewpoint with iconic photo of Haile Selassie
hu.text: Ez a kilátó történelmi jelentőségű, mivel a korábbi császár, Haile Selassie ikonikus fotóját mutatja be.

ro.name: Viewpoint with iconic photo of Haile Selassie
ro.text: Acest punct de belvedere are o semnificație istorică, deoarece prezintă fotografia iconică a fostului împărat Haile Selassie.

en.name: Viewpoint with iconic photo of Haile Selassie
en.text: This viewpoint holds historical significance as it features the iconic photograph of former Emperor Haile Selassie.
